knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A guard that has been taped back is a defect. Treat it as a stop: leave the saw unused and tag it out so it cannot be run with the guard bypassed.
Isolation is confirmed before adjustment, bit change or cleaning, with the battery removed.
Fine dust is inhalable, so respiratory protection and extraction are the controls.

practicalCriteria: instructions: Perform a simulated pre-use inspection, select task controls and demonstrate safe shutdown with an unplugged training tool.; evidence required: Reject faulty tools and document safe equipment selection without performing licensed work.; supervision: Competent supervisor; no unlicensed regulated work
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation record covering procedure steps 1-7
stopWorkCriteria: Stop work if procedure step 6 is not done: Isolate the tool before any adjustment, blade change or cleaning.
